provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Gloomhaven Rules Summary v85 (refs are its sections; [pNN] there points to the rulebook)

modules.name: Open information
modules.note: Playing with open hands also raises monster level and trap damage by 1.

steps.text: Campaign: do a Road Event if the scenario isn't linked to where you are
Read the scenario introduction and special rules (not the numbered sections)
Scenario level = average character level / 2, rounded up{adj}
Solo: +1 to monster level and trap damage
Open information: +1 to monster level and trap damage
Lay out all map tiles; set up only the starting room (overlay tiles and monsters)
Replaying? Reset "Goal" treasure tiles, not numbered ones
Monsters by the {n}-character row of the scenario; randomize standee numbers
steps.note: Solo still uses at least 2 characters

steps.text: Monster stat cards in sleeves showing the monster level
Shuffle the ability deck of each monster type in the room
Shuffle the shared monster attack modifier deck
Apply scenario effects and add scenario modifier cards to the attack modifier decks
Each player draws 2 Battle Goals and secretly keeps 1
Equip items: 1 head, 1 body, 1 legs, one 2-handed or two 1-handed, small items = half your level rounded up
Shuffle your attack modifier deck: base 20 adjusted for perks, Sanctuary Bless cards, scenario effects and items
Build your hand from your active card pool up to your class's hand size
Only the starting room's contents are set up; the rest appear when doors open
Battle goals stay secret for the whole scenario
Everyone picks 2 cards face down, leading card on top
Draw 1 ability card per active monster type; act in initiative order
